root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `optimize_nodes()` recurses into the target quantifier body, the quantifier must not be a zero-repeat `{0}` body; when `qn->upper == 0`, the optimizer must stop instead of descending into that subtree.
root_cause_criterion.description: On the crashing witness, the target `\g<3>{0}` quantifier still reaches the recursive `optimize_nodes()` body walk with `qn->upper == 0`, so the protected `call_body_recurse` event executes on the stale CALL body. In the real fixed image the original witness is guarded at this site, and the adjacent `quant_upper_2_witness` mutation shows the same quantifier site recursing only when `qn->upper` is nonzero.

nodes.state: The BAG_MEMORY node selected from the zero-length look-behind is actually freed during the `onig_node_reset_empty()` cleanup, so any later CALL-body alias to that node is stale.

At the `NODE_CALL` optimizer case, the recursive body argument `NODE_BODY(node)` is the same pointer as the freed capture target, proving the CALL node still carries the stale alias after the look-behind subtree was reset.
The AddressSanitizer sink dereferences the same capture-target pointer as the `node` parameter at `switch (NODE_TYPE(node))`, completing the stale CALL-body path into the invalid read.

edges.relation: The target quantifier's body pointer is passed unchanged into the nested `optimize_nodes()` call, so the optimizer next handles the same CALL node that the missing zero-repeat guard should have pruned.

The exact BAG_MEMORY node freed during the look-behind reset remains stored on the CALL node and is later reused as the CALL-body recursive argument, establishing the free-before-use link on the same pointer.
The same CALL-body pointer passed into the nested `optimize_nodes()` call becomes the `node` parameter immediately dereferenced by `NODE_TYPE(node)` at the sink.
